name: Cleansing of the Orb of Orahil
label: Quest
description: Cleansing of the Orb of Orahil: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Ah, a summoner's orb--this is where the taint must be coming from. We must exorcise the demon within it if you're to use it. That I can do easily.
You're the one who has the hard job. You must kill the demon once I release it.
And you'll have to be quick. If you take too long then he'll return to the orb and we'll have to start over!
So get yourself ready, friend. Prepare your strongest spells and keep your potions handy, and go get a friend if you have one. Because this isn't going to be pretty.

clips.title: Progress
paras: You'll have to kill that demon to remove its presence permanently from the orb, friend.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Nicely done, friend! You gave that demon a lesson he won't soon forget. You've shown great power and skill. Now I suppose it's time you return to Menara with your cleansed orb so you can put it to good use.
Good luck, adventurer. Perhaps our paths will cross again.
